pages.text: The Catalyst is step one of a crystal farm: it $(4)burns Akaishi Energy to make Geodes grow$(0) clusters on their own.$(br2)$(bold)Four tiers$(0) (range side / success chance / energy per tick):$(li)$(4)Basic$(0): 3x3x3, 20%, 5 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5, 30%, 25 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9, 40%, 125 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16, 50%, 625 E/t$(br2)Higher tiers are stronger but thirstier. Pipe power into it before you let it run.

Clusters only grow next to $(bold)Akaishi Crystal Geodes$(0). Geodes come in four grades: $(4)Flawed -> Normal -> Pristine -> Perfect$(0); the higher the grade, the faster they grow on their own.$(br2)$(bold)What the Catalyst does:$(0) every tick, each Geode in range gets one growth attempt — the Akaishi Crystal Clusters that sprout drop 1-2 Akaishi Essence when broken.$(br2)$(bold)Upgrading a Geode?$(0) Take it to the "$(l:akaishi:aggregator)Energy Aggregator$(/l)": 10M energy per grade.
Where Geodes and crystals come from: "$(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystals & Essence$(/l)". Want an idle crystal farm? Read the "$(l:akaishi:collector)Auto Collector$(/l)" next.
